contest: Whoever placed the round's last minion.

story.line: Purple is "battling for a token… you kind of want the last turn token" (Cory, Nov 7): bend when turns happen, and fight over the Goes Last token.
story.greatGame: Round I: take Sleep In for the token and some purple, and pick up a cheap token member (Sleepyheads or Pocket Watch's cloak). Round II: Crunch Time or Right Away grabs two best spaces before rivals can react, and Last Call cashes in waiting minions and takes the token back if someone stole it. Round III: Overtime takes the token for the +10 contest, and Closer makes the last space count twice. Rivals answer by taking the token back or taking the leftover spaces themselves.
freshStart: Space I: "+3 purple. Take the Goes Last token: your next minion is placed after everyone else's."
Space II: "Give the Goes Last token to any player. +1 follower per minion they have left."
Space III: "Take the Goes Last token. +2 followers per rival who still has a minion."
Member: "On Use, once per round: take the Goes Last token."
Member: "Whenever you lose the Goes Last token, +3 purple."
Member: "Whenever you take a consecutive turn, give the Goes Last token to any player."

cards.name: Sleep In
cards.text: +4 purple in round I, +5 in round II, +6 in round III. Take the Goes Last token: your next minion is placed after everyone else’s.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 4 players: Ana takes Sleep In with her third minion: +5 purple, +3 more from the Purple cloak, +3 followers from Sleepyheads. Her last minion waits until everyone is out, takes whatever is left, and she wins Purple's contest (+6 followers).
cards.topCase: Round III, Ana built around the token (cloak, Sleepyheads, Closer): +6 purple, +3 purple, +3 followers, her last minion does its space twice, and +10 followers for Purple's contest if nobody takes the token back. About 13 followers and 9 purple, against Largesse's +10 followers. Big but answerable: Overtime or Last Call takes the token back, so it doesn't break the game.
cards.ideaWhy: Take the token and some purple; the name says what happens.
cards.ties: It is the token's main way in, so it feeds every 'whenever you take the Goes Last token' card and gives the holder the last pick of every color's leftover spaces.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 28: "maybe more like 4/5/6". Nov 1: "Skip your next turn; take it after rivals have placed their last minions" (his idea for it).
cards.why: The round I way into the token fight and it works; nothing on record says Cory loves it, and a rival's answer is only Overtime or Last Call.

cards.name: Hold Up
cards.text: +2 purple in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. Whoever’s turn is next skips it, even yours.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: Ben sees Cal is next and Initiation ("Recruit a member in the shop costing 10 or less, for free. +1 red.") is still open. Ben takes Hold Up: +4 purple, Cal's turn is skipped, Dee takes Initiation instead. Cal feels it; Ben gets 4 purple and the satisfaction.
cards.topCase: Round III, used every chance with Gossip and Bouncers out: +4 purple and +1 follower from Gossip, about 2 followers' worth against Largesse's +10. It denies a space more than it pays. No break.
cards.ideaWhy: Delay the next player; one line, a table sees it.
cards.ties: It shuffles who gets every color's contested space next, and is the main source of skips for Gossip.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22: "the skip should replace catch up"; "1 purple per round i think is right but the wording is wrong". Oct 25: raised to +2/+3/+4 ("sure let's do it for all of them"). Nov 1: "yes" to the wording "Whoever's turn is next skips it, even yours."
cards.why: A sting every player understands; small gain, and it doesn't touch the Goes Last token fight.

cards.name: Right Away
cards.text: +1 purple. Your next turn comes right after this one, and that space gives +2 more of its color in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. (approved Nov 7, not built yet; live still reads "+2 purple in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. Your next turn comes right after this one.")
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 4 players: Ana takes Right Away (+1 purple), then at once takes Toast ("+3 silver in round I, +6 in round II, +9 in round III. Each rival +1 silver in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III."): 6 + 3 = 9 silver, a silver lead nobody can answer before her next turn.
cards.topCase: Round III, with Lookouts and Courier: +1 purple, then a space with +4 more (Toast +13 silver, Help Yourself steals 9), plus +2 followers from Lookouts and +1 of each other color from Courier. About 1.5 spaces in one go, against Initiation's free member. Strong, not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Two turns back to back, the second one bigger; one sentence.
cards.ties: It boosts whichever color's space you take next, so it reaches every color through the space, never by name.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7: "I like Right Away a lot". Nov 6 (live version): "your next turn, now, should give 2 purple… it should scale more… like 2/3/4".
cards.why: Cory's praise, and it makes a two-turn combo the table watches land.

cards.name: Last Call
cards.text: +1 purple. +1 follower and +1 purple per minion you have left. Take the Goes Last token: your other minions are placed after everyone else’s.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: Dee places her first of 5 minions on Last Call: +5 purple, +4 followers, the token (+3 purple cloak, +3 followers Sleepyheads). Her other 4 minions all go after everyone's, and she places the round's last minion for Purple's contest (+10).
cards.topCase: Round III, first minion, built around it: +8 purple and +7 followers right away, plus +10 for the contest if nobody takes the token back, against Largesse's +10 followers. Cost: her other 4 minions get only leftover spaces. About twice the best space when it lands; close to the line, held back by Overtime taking the token.
cards.ideaWhy: Go first, cash in your waiting minions, go last; one trade.
cards.ties: Every rival gets all the good spaces of every color while the holder waits, a real gift to the table that balances the payout.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: "actually, maybe we keep it one follower, and give purple per minion?", "also keep +1 purple up front". Nov 4: "1 one per minion left". Oct 30: "leave it for now".
cards.why: A big early cash-in with a real cost; Cory has tuned it many times without praising it.

cards.name: Crunch Time
cards.text: +2 purple. Your next two turns come right after this one.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 4 players: Cal takes Crunch Time and then at once takes Recruit Twice ("Recruit an extra time this turn. +3 blue.") and Help Yourself ("Steal 4 resources from one rival.") before anyone can block, then Hot Streak pays +6 followers.
cards.topCase: Round III, with Lookouts, Courier and Hot Streak: three spaces in a row (Crunch Time, Initiation, Largesse if open), +4 followers from Lookouts, +2 of each other color from Courier, +6 from Hot Streak once. Strong, and it costs no minion, but the round's late turns are gone, so it doesn't break the game.
cards.ideaWhy: Three turns in a row; nobody needs it explained.
cards.ties: It takes the best spaces of every color before rivals can react, and is the main engine for Lookouts, Courier and Hot Streak.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 21: "Crunch Time is great"; "Crunch time doesn't need any explanation… only you overthought it." Oct 22: "it's quite strong". Oct 25: "extremely strong in the right hands".
cards.why: Cory's praise, and three turns in a row is the biggest timing moment in the game.

cards.name: Overtime
cards.text: +4 purple. +1 minion this round. Take the Goes Last token: that minion is placed after everyone else’s.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: Eve sees Ana has held the token since Sleep In. Eve takes Overtime: +4 purple, +3 from the cloak, +3 followers from Sleepyheads, a sixth minion placed last, and the +10 Purple contest moves from Ana to her.
cards.topCase: Round III, built around it: +7 purple, +3 followers, one extra space, and the +10 contest swing (a 20-follower swing against the old holder), against Initiation's free member up to 10. Strong, and only once per game. No break.
cards.ideaWhy: An extra minion that goes last; the round III way to take the token.
cards.ties: It takes the token from whoever had it, so the old holder's minions go back to normal turns: the sting the token fight needs.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "Overtime is good. I like it". Nov 7: "purple needs another way to get last token then".
cards.why: Cory's praise, and it is round III's steal-the-token moment.

cards.name: Go-Getter
cards.text: On Use, once per game: +1 minion, placed right after this turn.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: Ben takes Initiation (free member up to 10), then uses Go-Getter and his extra minion takes Largesse (+10 followers) before anyone else can.
cards.topCase: Round III, once per game: one extra space, about 10 followers at best, against Extra Shift's same extra minion and Overtime's. For 9 resources it is fine, but it happens once, and never in round I.
cards.ideaWhy: One extra minion, right now.
cards.ties: It takes a second space from every color's board, with no part in the token fight.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22: asked whether Go-Getter's extra turn duplicates others. Oct 30: "Go-Getter stays 7".
cards.why: Third '+1 minion' card beside Extra Shift and Overtime, once per game, and it never touches the Goes Last token.

cards.name: Late Risers
cards.text: Round Start: if you have the fewest followers (ties count), +1 minion, placed before anyone else.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: Eve trails by 12. At round start she places an extra minion first, on Initiation (free member up to 10), then takes her normal first turn too.
cards.topCase: Round III, trailing every round: two extra spaces in the game (rounds II and III), best one about 10 followers, against 2 followers for a leader who owns it. Fair for a catch-up card; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: The trailing player gets a head start.
cards.ties: It gives the trailing player first pick of every color's best space, a catch-up all colors feel.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 30: +1 follower and +1 member ("change the names accordingly").
cards.why: A clear catch-up moment, but another '+1 minion' and nothing to do with the token.

cards.name: Courier
cards.text: Whenever you take a consecutive turn, +1 of each other color.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 4 players, four other colors in play: Cal takes Crunch Time, then two more turns at once: Courier pays +4 resources twice, 8 in all.
cards.topCase: Round III, with Crunch Time, Right Away and the snake's end seat: about 4 consecutive turns, +16 resources, worth about 16 followers if bought, against Largesse's +10. Strong, under twice; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Stack your turns, get a bit of everything.
cards.ties: It feeds every other color's members, but a gain in every color is Yellow's job (going broad).
cards.coryNotes: Nov 4: "I actually kind of like the old courier here. It just needs to be reworded whenever you take a consecutive turn… it benefits you to stack your turns all together."
cards.why: Cory likes it mildly; the reward overlaps Yellow's job.

cards.name: Bouncers
cards.text: On Recruit: the next two rivals’ turns are skipped.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: Ana recruits Bouncers just as Ben and Cal are about to take Initiation and Largesse; both are skipped, and Ana's next turn comes first.
cards.topCase: Round III, recruited at the best moment: 2 followers and 2 members for 6, plus first pick of the best space ahead of two rivals, about a space's worth once. Fair; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Recruit them and the next two players are held at the door.
cards.ties: It shifts who gets every color's next space, and feeds Gossip.
cards.why: A cheap, clear sting with one strong moment; no part in the token fight.

cards.name: Pocket Watch
cards.text: Whenever you take the Goes Last token, +3 purple.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Ana takes Last Call and the token: +3 purple on top.
cards.topCase: Round III, taking the token every round (Sleep In, Last Call, Overtime): about 9 purple a game. Holders got about 6 a game in bot games, under Cory's 10 to 12 for a cloak.
cards.ideaWhy: Take the token, get paid.
cards.ties: It points the holder at the token fight from the start.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "when you take the Go Last token" (cloak), "+3 (probably +2 if 43%), but lets try +3". Nov 7: "ok" on the cloak set.
cards.why: Clean and on Purple's story; it may pay too little, which is a number, not the idea.

cards.name: Gossip
cards.text: Whenever a player’s turn is skipped, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: Ben takes Hold Up, Cal's turn is skipped: +1 follower to whoever owns Gossip.
cards.topCase: Round III, with Hold Up every round and Bouncers: about 4 skips a game, +4 followers for 7 resources, against buying 7 followers outright. Flat.
cards.ideaWhy: Skips pay you.
cards.ties: It only pays off Hold Up and Bouncers; Sleep In no longer skips (it takes the token), so skips are rare.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: "1 yes" to bringing it back in Extra Shift's place; stays as printed (any player's skip). Oct 23: "should pay when turn is actually skipped".
cards.why: Pays less than buying followers with the same 7 resources, since skips got rare when the token arrived.

cards.name: Extra Shift
cards.text: On Recruit: +1 minion this round.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: Dee recruits Extra Shift and her extra minion takes Largesse (+10 followers).
cards.topCase: Round III, recruited early: one extra space, about 10 followers at best, for 11 resources, against Go-Getter's and Overtime's same extra minion. Flat.
cards.ideaWhy: One more minion this round.
cards.ties: It takes one more space from any color's board.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: swapped out of the 10-card deck for Gossip, Claude's words "a worse Night Owl" ("1 yes").
cards.why: Cory already took it out of the 10-card deck; the priciest twin of Go-Getter and Overtime.

cards.name: Timekeeper
cards.text: Game End: +1 follower per purple member you have.
cards.bestTurn: Game end: Fay holds 5 purple members; Timekeeper adds +5 followers.
cards.topCase: Round III, built around it with 6 purple members (some counting as 2, so about 8): +8 followers for 6 resources, against buying 6 followers. Fine; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Go deep in purple, paid at the end.
cards.ties: It rewards taking purple members away from rivals in the shop.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22: "no follower per purple" (cut the per-purple-resource version). Oct 25: "yes" to keeping names and prices.
cards.why: A plain go-deep payoff, quiet but useful; it repeats Night Managers' count.

cards.name: Lookouts
cards.text: Whenever you take a consecutive turn, +2 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Cal takes Crunch Time and two turns at once: +4 followers from Lookouts.
cards.topCase: Round III, with Crunch Time, Right Away and the end seat: about 4 consecutive turns, +8 followers in the round and about 14 over the game, against Largesse's +10 once. Strong, under twice; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Stack your turns, get followers.
cards.ties: Same trigger as Courier, with followers instead of resources.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "yea but plus 2 followers. fuck it just add them both."
cards.why: Clear and strong, but a twin of Courier's trigger and not part of the token fight.

cards.name: Sleepyheads
cards.text: Whenever you take the Goes Last token, +3 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: Eve takes Overtime and the token: +3 followers, and she pulls the +10 contest off Ana.
cards.topCase: Round III, taking the token every round: +9 followers a game for 7, against buying 7. Fine; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Take the token, gain followers.
cards.ties: It makes taking the token worth a turn even when the contest is lost.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "1 ok" on adding it; Nov 6 12:24am: "1 yes to sleepyheads. maybe even more" (raised to +3).
cards.why: Cory asked for more of it, and it is the token fight's plainest reward.

cards.name: Night Managers
cards.text: Round End: if you placed the round’s last minion, +1 follower per purple member you have.
cards.bestTurn: Round III end: Dee placed the last minion and holds 6 purple members (Night Managers counts as 2): +6 followers, on top of Purple's +10 contest.
cards.topCase: Round III, 7 purple members counted, last minion in rounds II and III: about +12 followers, against buying 6. Under twice the best space; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Two conditions (last minion and a purple count).
cards.ties: It doubles down on the contest's own trigger, so whoever holds the token wins twice.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "night manager yes". Nov 6: "night managers should be worth 2 members".
cards.why: Cory picked it, but it pays the same moment as Purple's contest and Closer.

cards.name: Closer
cards.price: [6 purple + 5 any, worth 1] (approved price, not built yet)
cards.text: When you place the round's last minion, do that space's action again. (approved Nov 7, not built yet; live still reads "When you place the last minion of the round: +4 purple.")
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Dee holds the token. Two spaces are left, Help Yourself ("Steal 3 resources in round I, 4 in round II, 5 in round III from one rival.") and Build Up. Her last minion takes Help Yourself twice: steal 8.
cards.topCase: Round III, holding the token each round: one leftover space done twice, about +5 to +10 more per round. Risk: on Overtime it gives another minion placed last, which may let it repeat; the words need a once-per-round answer.
cards.ideaWhy: Go last, and your last space counts twice.
cards.ties: It makes rivals choose between taking the best leftover space and leaving it for the closer, so the table plays around it.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7: "I like Closer a lot. I think it's actually really strong", "quite expensive".
cards.why: Cory's praise, and the clearest payoff for winning the token fight.

cards.name: Hot Streak
cards.text: On Use, once per game: +3 followers per turn in a row you’ve taken just before this one.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Cal takes Crunch Time, then two turns at once; on the third turn he uses Hot Streak: +6 followers.
cards.topCase: Round III, end seat of the snake plus Crunch Time: 3 turns in a row before it, +9 followers once, against Largesse's +10. No break.
cards.ideaWhy: Cash in your streak once.
cards.ties: It turns Crunch Time and Right Away into followers.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: "I like hot streak". Nov 4: "sounds like bots are using Hot Streak completely wrong". Also on record: "What's wrong with hot streak?"
cards.why: Cory's praise, and a once-a-game payoff a player plans a round around.

cards.name: Picket Line
cards.text: Whenever a rival takes a Purple space, +1 purple.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: rivals take Sleep In and Hold Up; the owner gets +2 purple without doing anything.
cards.topCase: Round III, with rivals on purple spaces about 3 times a round: about 6 to 9 purple a game, plus 3 followers and 3 members for 6. Fine on paper; no break.
cards.ideaWhy: A follower card with a passive purple trickle stuck on.
cards.ties: It pays you for rivals using Purple, a passive gain.
cards.coryNotes: Cory has said nothing on this card; it went in on the director's call Nov 4. On cloaks he said gains must come from your own actions: "you cant passively gain from it" (Nov 6).
cards.why: A passive gain from rivals' turns, the kind Cory turned down for cloaks, and nothing to do with the token.

overlaps: Go-Getter "On Use, once per game: +1 minion, placed right after this turn." and Extra Shift "On Recruit: +1 minion this round." (and Overtime's "+1 minion this round"): three ways to the same extra minion.
Courier "Whenever you take a consecutive turn, +1 of each other color." and Lookouts "Whenever you take a consecutive turn, +2 followers.": same trigger.
Sleepyheads "Whenever you take the Goes Last token, +3 followers." and Purple's cloak Pocket Watch "Whenever you take the Goes Last token, +3 purple.": same trigger.

Night Managers "Round End: if you placed the round's last minion, +1 follower per purple member you have." and Closer "When you place the round's last minion, do that space's action again.": same moment, which is also Purple's contest.
Night Managers and Timekeeper "Game End: +1 follower per purple member you have.": same count.
Courier with Yellow's going-broad job, e.g. Melting Pot "+2 yellow, and +1 of each color among your members.": a gain in every color.
notes: Only three spaces (Sleep In, Last Call, Overtime) and no members take the Goes Last token, and nothing pays the player who loses it, so the token fight Cory wants is thin outside the spaces. Four members are about extra minions or skips, not the token. Round III is strong (Overtime plus Closer); the weak cards are Go-Getter, Extra Shift, Gossip and Picket Line. Closer on Overtime needs a ruling before it's built.
